title: normalizeTrackerItemFields
responsibility: Normalize Tracker item input into scalar fields accepted by the operation journal.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerCron.value
inputs.description: Five-field cron expression or supported shorthand to validate.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerCron.timeZone
inputs.description: IANA time zone used to evaluate the recurrence.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerCron.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds used to start the schedule's five-year search window.

inputs.name: trackerCronOccurrences.raw
inputs.description: Five-field cron expression or supported shorthand used to build the schedule.

inputs.name: trackerCronOccurrences.timeZone
inputs.description: IANA time zone used to locate each occurrence in local wall-clock order.

inputs.name: trackerDateFormatter.timeZone
inputs.description: IANA time zone for calendar date and time parts.

inputs.name: trackerDateParts.time
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds to break into localized calendar parts.

inputs.name: trackerDateParts.formatter
inputs.description: Formatter configured for the caller's time zone.

inputs.name: trackerLocalStamp.time
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds to format as a local day and minute.

inputs.name: trackerLocalStamp.timeZone
inputs.description: IANA time zone used for the local stamp.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerDue.value
inputs.description: Due date as a day, timestamp, relative expression, or a clear value.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerDue.clock
inputs.description: Current epoch time and optional time zone used to resolve relative dates.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerReminder.value
inputs.description: Future ISO date and time with an explicit time zone.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerReminder.now
inputs.description: Current epoch time in milliseconds for future-time validation.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerParkUntil.value
inputs.description: A Lisbon calendar date or an ISO timestamp with an explicit time zone.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerParkUntil.now
inputs.description: Current time in epoch milliseconds for validation.

inputs.name: trackerIsoTime.epoch
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds to format as an ISO timestamp.

inputs.name: validateTrackerTimeZone.timeZone
inputs.description: Proposed IANA time zone to validate.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerItemFields.input
inputs.description: The Store field map with unvalidated values. Undefined values are omitted and recorded values are journal-ready scalars.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerItemFields.clock
inputs.description: The caller supplies the node, epoch milliseconds and applicable policy or time-zone inputs.

inputs.name: clearsTrackerRecurrence.value
inputs.description: Proposed recurrence value to check for a clear request.

inputs.name: requestsTrackerLaunch.value
inputs.description: Requested auto-launch value to check for a launch request.

inputs.name: trackerItemPriority.value
inputs.description: Stored or supplied priority string. Accepted values are urgent, normal and low.

inputs.name: trackerItemPriority.fallback
inputs.description: Priority returned for absent or unrecognized legacy data when the caller supplies a default.

inputs.name: trackerItemValueOr.value
inputs.description: Tracker field value that may be absent or empty.

inputs.name: trackerItemValueOr.fallback
inputs.description: Replacement returned when the input is absent or empty.

outputs.name: normalizeTrackerItemFields
outputs.description: Mutation fields normalized to the Tracker journal representation.

errors.name: TrackerItemRequestError
errors.description: A request with invalid Tracker input carries status 400 and a compatibility message.
